beastlabai-multi-llm-plugin-multi-llm.description: Orchestrate code plan reviews, task generation, implementation, and code reviews using multiple LLM providers in parallel, or ask each model a free-text question about a plan. Use this skill whenever the user wants to review a plan with multiple models, generate implementation tasks, implement tasks with subagent delegation, review code changes against a plan, ask the models a question about a plan, or run any multi-model workflow. Triggers on: 'review my plan', 'multi-llm', 'run code review', 'generate tasks from plan', 'implement this plan', 'use multiple models to review', 'ask the models…
